rebirth-a-cat-with-a-system:
A biker tries to save a cat on the highway and gets hit by a truck (Truck-Kun), he was rushed to the hospital but, due to internal bleeding, he dies only to be reborn as a cat, in a new world with a system.
In this new and vast world, he tries his best to get used to his new body and get stronger along the way. With his overpowered system and skills. To one day become untouchable.
reborn-into-a-slash-game:
Suo Fei, a veteran NEET has spent three days and three nights strategizing his way through the highly explicit H danmei game masterpiece “Yalance”. Furthermore, he was able to capture all nine little shous from the nine great races. However, as the final, 10P feast was approaching, he unexpectedly transmigrated. He transmigrated into the real country of Yalance…
Suo Fei: Hey, hey, hey, can you delete these files and let me restart? What the hell did Laozi transmigrate into!
reborn-to-guide-the-defective-sentinel:
Xin Linhua had three rules after being reborn:
Don’t get involved in trouble.
Don’t attract attention.
And absolutely, under no circumstances, get involved with anyone in the institute.
Naturally, he broke all three on his very first day.
After getting backstabbed by the only person he trusted, he was reborn into a world where Sentinels possess terrifying abilities and Guides are responsible for keeping them sane.
Xin Linhua discovers that he has somehow become a Guide.
An F-Rank guide with zero abilities and a terrible reputation.
Great. The heavens are against him!
Maybe he'll make the most of it and become a wastrel, think of it as a forever vacation in another world away from earth.
What he doesn’t expect is to be assigned to a defective Sentinel.
A beautiful, blindfolded, utterly terrifying youth with undiagnosed anger issues, and who has a rather unusual habit of killing anyone who gets too close to him.
Xin Linhua probably should be concerned, terrified out of his mind. He isn't.
Instead, he thinks he has found a very amusing bodyguard. A small, feisty but caring bodyguard.…
reincarnated-as-a-flower-fine-then-ill-b: Sumi has always despised the world she lives in—one filled with greed, deceit, and pain. Trapped in a miserable life with a dead-end job and mounting debt, she sees no escape. But when her lecherous boss crosses the line, Sumi reaches her breaking point. In a desperate act, she takes her own life—only to awaken in the darkness and found out that her wish has been granted she is no longer human she finds herself in the most unexpected form… a seed of a flower and she was in the world which she only knows in game and stories. a world where creature like demon, monster and things like magic and spells exist and she is going to live her second life… as a flower.
reincarnation-i-have-always-been-rich:
“Qu Meng’er was born with a silver spoon in her mouth, but her father had tampered with her brakes and ended her life in a car accident.
Little did Qu Meng’er expect that her death would make her reborn.
When she reopened her eyes, she had become a little bundle, a little bundle born in the 70s that had been discarded after someone wrongly took her away.
Qu Meng’er, the abandoned baby, was adopted by the Chen couple. Qu Meng’er also changed her name to Chen Meng’er.
Therefore, Chen Meng’er started to live her life anew.
She wanted to see what kinds of changes Chen Meng’er would bring to the poverty-stricken Chen family with her personal spatial dimensions, memories and knowledge from her previous life.
She also wanted to know how she would be when she came face to face with the members of the Qu family who wanted her to return home.
soul-swappingimperial-concubine-rebirth: The Third Miss of the Qin Clan is a useless and timid person. When the Prince withdraws from her marriage, she commits suicide by jumping into the river. In the 21st century, Qin Chu, a genius agent, is framed and his soul crosses over to the Third Miss of the Qin Clan. So what if she’s useless,
sss-investment-legendary-rewards-from-my:
Reinhard woke up in a life that was already falling apart. His new family hated him. His wife, Emily Ashcroft, was confined to a wheelchair after her Gnosis shattered and ended her career as one of the world's most talented young Awakeners.
It was a hopeless situation. But it was the sight of his wife placing a blanket over him and water after his drunken night that made him curious about her. And the first thing he wanted to do was make her smile again.
Then a mysterious system appeared before him.
[Akasha Investment System Activated.]
[Target: Emily Ashcroft.]
[Current Value: E.]
[Investment Potential: SSS.]
[Investment Difficulty: SSS-Rank.]
[Estimated Return: Legendary.]
Reinhard thought it was a joke. Until he spent $2,000 on his wife's medicine.
The result?
[$30,000 Credits.]
[Legendary Reward Obtained: Merchant King's Lens.]
The more Reinhard invested in Emily, the greater the returns became. The rewards could be money, Legendary skills, Legendary items, knowledge, or opportunities that should have been impossible for an ordinary Awakener to obtain.
But Reinhard soon discovered that Emily's shattered Gnosis wasn't the only thing he could restore. Her legs could be healed.…
supreme-warrior-in-the-city:
Three years ago, he got into serious trouble for a woman's sake and ended up serving a three-year sentence.
Three years later, he returned triumphant, only to find that the woman had sided with their enemies, and his closest friend had been ruined.
In life, simplicity reigns: with the sky above, the earth below, brothers in the heart, and the beloved in the embrace, one needs nothing more.
Yet, life is not always simple: facing obstacles from gods and buddhas alike, he vows to conquer all challenges across three thousand worlds. Nothing can stand in his way!
that-time-my-anime-life-got-cursed-by-ou:
Shiro Sakamaki was reborn into a new world with one simple goal: to live a peaceful, luxurious life free from drama.
But when he transfers to a prestigious high school in Tokyo, he quickly discovers that his new reality is anything but ordinary. The city is a strange mix of supernatural forces, ghostly phenomena, and events that feel like they’ve jumped straight out of an anime.
Before long, bizarre occurrences follow him everywhere, along with a series of beautiful, mysterious girls—from the arrogant, blonde twin-tailed exorcist, to the mysterious quintuplet sisters, to a passerby heroine with hidden powers.
As Shiro gets tangled in the supernatural chaos, he realizes he’s at the center of something far darker. Cursed relics begin to surface, and Ancient, Evil Outer Gods—whose very presence bends reality—start to stir.
Now, Shiro must figure out why he’s caught in this web of strange occurrences while trying to survive school and the surreal new world he’s been thrust into.
the-chancellors-darling-reborn-for-venge:
In her past life, she was a pampered noble lady from a scholarly family, but ended up as a plaything in the hands of a tyrant. On a snowy night, she died naked, with no grave to call her own.
Reborn, she pulls out her hairpin without hesitation and stabs it toward that person's neck. A blood debt must be paid in blood — so let it begin here......
The world calls her a disaster — so she'll topple the world that betrayed her. Her scumbag husband wants to trade her for power? She'll ruin him. The tyrant wants to keep her as a plaything? She'll make him wish he'd never been born.
But the cold-faced minister who once controlled the court from the shadows — in this life, he keeps her close to his heart, cherishing her as his most precious treasure, helping her settle every debt and slay every enemy, promising her a lifetime of peace and love.
the-epic-of-the-discarded-son:
Look, when your own father throws you into a well full of venomous snakes, you’re supposed to die.
That’s basically the entire point of the exercise.
But Shiro didn’t die.Mostly out of spite.
He spent years down there in the dark, eating snakes, training until his body literally broke and rebuilt itself, and having conversations with a voice in his head that may or may not have been telling him the truth.
And he is definitely not crazy
the-golden-winged-of-football-haruma-kus:
This isn't just a game for me, it's a fckin war! And I will conquer it, no matter what…… I'm coming for it all!
A wild journey of a boy from Japan named Haruma Kusaka, who hates Football the most… Yet is obsessed with winning everything that exists in this game, creating a legacy that no one can ever match.
the-most-powerful-overlord: As the most promising child of the most powerful family, Ye Qingtian was exiled because of his Abandoned Celestial Destiny. No one knows, though he was young at the time, Ye never forgot those who turned back on him and swore to take his revenge.

Regressor, Reincarnator, Possessor, Traveler, or Predestined. I will hunt down the protagonists that exist in the countless worlds and absorb their abilities.

The continent’s hope.
The hero who will save the world.
The hero who currently has a hole through his chest!
With the Spirit of Earth, freed the Dwarfs and gained their trust.
Purified the contaminated Forest of Spirits and became the Fairies’ benefactor.
Resealed the Ancient Stone statues found in one of the ruins.
Exterminated the giant sea serpent that emerged from the sea.
Defeated the 47th Demon Lord of the underworld…
“Aside from assaults and mu*ders there were other death related incidents as well as vandalism, arson, and etc…”
“S-spare me…”
Psh!
That was the protagonist.
But now, he has died by my hands.
the-regressed-demon-lord-is-kind:
My whole life, all I wanted was power.
I churned the world into rivers of blood and eventually gained the title, ‘Demon Lord of Strength’. However, all this became useless when I lost to a party of heroes.
But what can a loser say? As I laid dying, I was forced to listen to the hero’s gibberish:
“If you are born again, I hope that you will live a kind life!”
But huh? When I opened my eyes again, I was back in the past.
“What do I have to do to live a kind life?”
This is the beginning of an ex-Demon Lord’s journey to live a ‘kind’ life.
the-strongest-dandy-in-the-city: Five hundred years later, a superhuman talent cultivated by the state perished during a mission, and his soul transmigrated, taking possession of the body of a young master from a prominent family who suffered from an anxiety disorder. From that moment on, his extraordinary life began, spanning across various fields such as business and medicine. Wherever he set foot, others could only look up to him.

the-villains-system-care-for-your-crippl:
Rivelius Kane conquered a world.
Kingdoms burned at his word. Armies broke before his banner. When the last resistance fell, he stood alone at the top, undisputed, undefeated, unstoppable.
So the universe cheated.
He wakes in another world, at the altar of his own wedding, in a body that is, unsettlingly, still his own.
The name on the marriage contract says Rivelius Kane, heir of one of the empire's most powerful military houses. The reputation says drunkard, gambler, disgrace. A man who inherited everything and earned nothing.
The bride is Princess Cordelia Virellon of the Aurelian Empire, crippled by a war wound the throne would rather forget, married off to a wastrel because burying her with a powerful house is easier than admitting she still matters.
Neither of them knows what they actually got.
A System locks onto Rivelius before the vows finish: complete your objective, and go home; army, empire, power, all of it, waiting exactly as he left it. He agrees before he even reads the terms. How hard can one task be for a man who's already conquered a world?
[Main Objective: Ensure the physical and emotional well-being of your wife.…
villain-takes-over-the-academy:
Some say reincarnation is a blessing, but for me, it's a dreadful curse.
Cursed with endless reincarnation, I've been reborn as a villain 137 times. And all 137 times, I've been toyed with and killed by heroes who are far more cruel than the said villains...
If I can't win no matter what I do, then I'll crush those so-called heroes at their very roots.

youkoso-jitsuryoku-shijou-shugi-no-kyous:
Kōdo Ikusei Senior High School, a leading prestigious school with state-of-the-art facilities where nearly 100% of students go on to university or find employment. The students there have the freedom to wear any hairstyle and bring any personal effects they desire. Kōdo Ikusei is a paradise-like school, but the truth is that only the most superior of students receive favorable treatment.
The protagonist Kiyotaka Ayanokōji is a student of D-class, which is where the school dumps its “inferior” students in order to ridicule them. For a certain reason, Kiyotaka was careless on his entrance examination, and was put in D-class. After meeting Suzune Horikita and Kikyō Kushida, two other students in his class, Kiyotaka’s situation begins to change.
